description: Superfund: Search Superfund (CERCLA/SEMS) sites by location or NPL listing status. Returns site identifiers, source NPL status labels, non-NPL assessment and archive metadata when available, coordinates, and county FIPS code. Accepts either state/city/ZIP, returned in SEMS site ID order, or latitude+longitude+radius for proximity searches, ordered nearest first; page through a large match with offset and nextOffset. Proximity searches match only sites with usable coordinates and share a 50-second deadline; narrow the radius or add filters if the search times out. Use epa_superfund_get_site with a returned siteId for contaminant associations.

city.description: City name (partial match within state, case-insensitive). Punctuation is matched as written ("St. Louis", "Coeur d'Alene").

exclude_archived.description: Exclude archived sites by requiring SEMS archived_ind=N; false retains all archive statuses

latitude.description: Latitude for proximity search (use with longitude and radius_miles)

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return in one call (1–200, default 50). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 200 with a notice. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

longitude.description: Longitude for proximity search (use with latitude and radius_miles)

npl_status.description: Filter by NPL status: listed=final or part of an NPL site (F,A), not-listed=N, proposed=P, deleted=D, removed=R, withdrawn=W, all=include all

offset.description: Number of sites to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles from the given coordinates. Required when using latitude+longitude.

state.description: 2-letter US state or territory code to filter sites, e.g. "WA"

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code to filter sites; a ZIP+4 searches its 5-digit ZIP. Matches sites recorded under the ZIP or any ZIP+4 within it.

name: epa_superfund_search_sites

effectiveQuery.description: The search as the server sent it upstream, in this tool's input names: normalized values, how each text filter matched ("=" exact, "contains", "begins with", "has words"), and defaults that change what comes back. Terms are separated by "; ".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incomplete_proximity`: Only part of latitude, longitude, and radius_miles was supplied, except latitude+longitude without radius_miles. `no_location_filter`: No location filter (state, city, zip_code, or latitude+longitude) was provided. `radius_required`: Latitude and longitude were provided without radius_miles. `invalid_state`: state has the 2-character form but is not a US state, DC, territory, freely associated state, UM, NN, or EPA region code. `unmatchable_filter`: city has no letter or digit for EPA's DMAP service to match on. `filter_too_long`: city makes a request longer than EPA's DMAP service accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Present when more sites follow: the offset that continues the search.

limitNotice.description: Present when limit was above the cap and the call returned the cap instead.

message.description: Recovery hint when no sites are found. Absent when sites are returned.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page: present exactly when more records follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Proximity coordinate-coverage limitation, with the page's place in the nearest-first match when the page does not hold every match; also present when a non-proximity punctuated city filter reaches its page limit.

items.description: Superfund site record with source status and assessment metadata

archivedInd.description: Raw SEMS archive indicator, such as Y or N

epaId.description: EPA site identifier distinct from the SEMS site ID

federalFacilityInd.description: Raw SEMS federal facility indicator, such as Y or N

nonNplStatusName.description: Non-NPL assessment label reported by SEMS; not cleanup progress

nplStatus.description: Raw NPL code: F=final, A=part of an NPL site, N=not listed, P=proposed, D=deleted, R=removed, W=withdrawn

nplStatusName.description: NPL status label reported by SEMS

totalCount.description: Superfund sites matched before limit and offset. Present for a proximity search, which ranks every match; absent for a state, city, or ZIP search, whose match count EPA's DMAP service does not report (follow nextOffset instead).

title: Search Superfund Sites
